highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.0 brings Skia m157 with rasterization, text, and GPU correctness improvements.
highlights_body: The cumulative line also corrects filtered-image sampling and mask-filtered glyph handling. LibraryImport declarations explicitly use cdecl; the public managed API remains unchanged.

breaking.title: Check Graphite Metal deployment targets
breaking.body: Graphite Metal now requires iOS or tvOS 15; its macOS minimum remains 12. Raise lower deployment targets before using this backend, and continue to honor any higher managed or framework requirements.

bullets.lead: Skia m157 with raster and glyph-replay corrections
bullets.detail: Updates the native engine and fixes convex antialiased path rasterization across vertical clip gaps, coverage-mask clamping, and direct-mask glyph replay validation. Graphite readback also uses the correct A-to-RGBx transfer stride.

bullets.lead: More reliable GPU geometry and text
bullets.detail: Corrects reflected hairline square caps, transformed ellipse and rounded-rectangle geometry, text-atlas selection, and stale atlas work after empty flushes. Graphite counts pending clips and skips draws whose clip stacks cannot fit a fresh render pass.

Prevents unrelated texels bleeding into antialiased or multisampled image subsets under minification and skew, and aligns filter-cache equality with hashing. Mask-filtered glyph reloads now respect changed paths, compatible mask formats, and full embossed-plane strides.

Adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers and propagates synchronous fence-wait failures inside native submission. GRContext.Submit remains void. Displacement offset arithmetic now matches fp32 filter bounds.

Generated LibraryImport declarations now match existing DllImport calling conventions across SkiaSharp, HarfBuzzSharp, and related bindings, addressing a potential Windows x86 ABI mismatch. The reported optimized-call stack-growth symptom still needs Windows x86 runtime validation.

preview_summaries.v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19: Release Candidate 2 corrects transformed GPU geometry, stale atlas work, and Graphite clip-capacity handling. It also improves displacement precision and native synchronous Vulkan wait reporting without adding a managed result.
preview_summaries.v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6: Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline caps and text-atlas selection, and adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers.
preview_summaries.v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1: Preview 1 introduces Skia m157 with rasterization, glyph-replay, and Graphite readback fixes, plus explicit cdecl LibraryImport declarations. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15, subject to higher framework requirements.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200 makes LibraryImport calling conventions explicitly cdecl. This package revision retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.headline: Preview 1 brings Skia m157 with rasterization, glyph-replay and Graphite readback fixes.
v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.body: LibraryImport declarations explicitly select cdecl. HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.200 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15, in addition to any higher framework requirements.

v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.headline: Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline caps and GPU text-atlas selection.
v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.body: It also adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers. These fixes do not change managed APIs.

v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19.headline: Release Candidate 2 improves transformed GPU geometry, Graphite clipping and displacement-filter precision.
v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19.body: It also corrects stale Ganesh atlas work and native synchronous Vulkan wait handling. GRContext.Submit remains void; no managed failure-reporting result is added.
